info.name: Ahlena Admin — Caregiver review notes
info.description: E07 append-only caregiver review notes for the admin caregiver review surface (CaregiverReviewAdmin). Both routes are Normal access with account_type SuperAdmin (5) or SupportAdmin (7); ContentAdmin, FinanceAdmin, Care Home owners, Family, Elderly and Caregiver tokens are denied with 403 and a missing, expired or non-Normal token with 401. POST appends exactly one immutable note and answers 201 with the created body; the author is the authenticated actor and the instant is the server's UTC clock, so a client-supplied authorUserId, createdOnUtc or noteId in the body is ignored. GET pages newest-first by createdOnUtc then note id descending, clamping page to at least 1 and pageSize to the 1-100 range (0 or absent means the default 20) instead of rejecting, and totalCount always covers the caregiver's whole note set. A missing caregiver is 404 Caregivers.ReviewNote.CaregiverNotFound, checked before the text, so a bad text never masks a missing caregiver; a missing, whitespace-only or over-2000-character text is 400 Caregivers.ReviewNote.InvalidText. No 409 and no 5xx path is reachable from request input: no route updates, deletes or transitions a note. These examples are authored, not runtime evidence; run only against disposable local fixtures.

request.description: CaregiverReviewAdmin. Reads one caregiver's administrative notes, newest first by createdOnUtc then note id descending as a stable tiebreak. Each item carries noteId, caregiverId, text, authorUserId and createdOnUtc and nothing else: no caregiver identity document, phone number, email address, medical fact or caregiver name is ever projected. An unknown or empty caregiverId is 404 Caregivers.ReviewNote.CaregiverNotFound; a caregiver that exists but has never been annotated is 200 with an empty items array and totalCount 0, never an error.

exec: pm.test('caregiver note list contract status', () => pm.expect([200, 401, 403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));
if (pm.response.code === 404) pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('Caregivers.ReviewNote.CaregiverNotFound');

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('page'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('pageSize'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('totalCount'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('items').that.is.an('array'); pm.expect(body.page).to.be.at.least(1); if (body.items.length > 0) { pm.collectionVariables.set('noteId', body.items[0].noteId); pm.expect(Object.keys(body.items[0]).sort()).to.eql(['authorUserId', 'caregiverId', 'createdOnUtc', 'noteId', 'text']); pm.expect(body.items[0].text).to.be.a('string'); } const raw = JSON.stringify(body); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('phoneNumber'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('email'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('identityNumber'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('medicalNotes'); }

item.name: List caregiver review notes (empty list is not an error)

request.description: A caregiver that exists and has never been annotated answers 200 with items [] and totalCount 0. Use a caregiver with no notes, or a page number past the last page: reading past the last page is also an empty page rather than an error, and totalCount still reports the caregiver's full note set.

exec: pm.test('empty caregiver note page contract', () => pm.expect([200, 401, 403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));
if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.totalCount).to.be.a('number'); }

item.name: List caregiver review notes (paging is clamped, never rejected)

request.description: The review-note read follows the house paging convention: page is clamped up to 1 and pageSize is capped at 100 with a floor of 1, and a pageSize of 0 or an absent pageSize means the default 20. The answer is 200 with the normalized page and pageSize echoed back, never a 400, because there is no filter to validate on this route. Replace the query with page=-3&pageSize=-1 to see the same normalization.

exec: pm.test('clamped caregiver note page contract', () => pm.expect([200, 401, 403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.pageSize).to.be.within(1, 100); pm.expect(body.items.length).to.be.at.most(body.pageSize); }

item.name: List an unknown caregiver's review notes

request.description: An unknown or empty caregiver id answers 404 Caregivers.ReviewNote.CaregiverNotFound even when the note table could have answered an empty page: existence is checked before the read, so a client can tell a missing caregiver from a caregiver with no notes.

exec: pm.test('unknown caregiver note list is 404', () => pm.expect([404, 401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code));
if (pm.response.code === 404) pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('Caregivers.ReviewNote.CaregiverNotFound');

request.description: CaregiverReviewAdmin. 201 Created with the created note body (noteId, caregiverId, text, authorUserId, createdOnUtc) so the caller can read back exactly what was stored. text is required, trimmed and 1-2000 characters; the stored value is the trimmed text verbatim, with no masking, truncation or markdown processing. Appending a note changes no caregiver state — no status, certificate, rating, payout or review decision — and sends no notification, email or domain event. The response sets noteId in this collection.

exec: pm.test('append caregiver note contract', () => pm.expect([201, 400, 401, 403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));
if (pm.response.code === 400) pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('Caregivers.ReviewNote.InvalidText');
if (pm.response.code === 404) pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('Caregivers.ReviewNote.CaregiverNotFound');

if (pm.response.code === 201) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Object.keys(body).sort()).to.eql(['authorUserId', 'caregiverId', 'createdOnUtc', 'noteId', 'text']); pm.expect(body.text).to.eql(JSON.parse(pm.request.body.raw).text.trim()); pm.expect(body.createdOnUtc).to.be.a('string'); pm.collectionVariables.set('noteId', body.noteId); }

item.name: Add a caregiver review note (whitespace text is rejected)

request.description: A missing, null, empty or whitespace-only text is 400 Caregivers.ReviewNote.InvalidText and stores nothing: the text is trimmed before the bound is checked, so a body of spaces cannot append a blank note. The same code covers the upper bound — replace the body with a 2001-character text to see it — so one code documents both text shapes without a separate validation envelope.

exec: pm.test('whitespace caregiver note text is 400', () => pm.expect([400, 401, 403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));
if (pm.response.code === 400) pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('Caregivers.ReviewNote.InvalidText');

item.name: Add a caregiver review note (over-2000-character text is rejected)

request.description: The 2000-character bound is inclusive: exactly 2000 characters are accepted and stored verbatim, 2001 are 400 Caregivers.ReviewNote.InvalidText. Replace the placeholder with a 2001-character string, then with exactly 2000 characters, to see both sides of the boundary. The bound is applied to the trimmed text.

exec: pm.test('over-long caregiver note text contract', () => pm.expect([400, 201, 401, 403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));
if (pm.response.code === 400) pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('Caregivers.ReviewNote.InvalidText');

item.name: Add a caregiver review note to an unknown caregiver

request.description: An unknown or empty caregiver id is 404 Caregivers.ReviewNote.CaregiverNotFound, checked before the text, so a bad text never masks a missing caregiver. Replace the body with whitespace to confirm the precedence: the answer stays 404, not 400.

exec: pm.test('unknown caregiver note append is 404', () => pm.expect([404, 400, 401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code));
if (pm.response.code === 404) pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('Caregivers.ReviewNote.CaregiverNotFound');

item.name: Add a caregiver review note (client author and timestamp are ignored)

request.description: The request body carries the text and nothing else that matters: authorUserId is the authenticated actor, createdOnUtc is the server's UTC clock and noteId is generated by the server. The three extra members above are accepted and ignored, so the 201 body must echo none of them — a returned authorUserId of 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 or a createdOnUtc of 2000-01-01 would mean client attribution was honoured.

exec: pm.test('client attribution is ignored', () => pm.expect([201, 400, 401, 403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));

if (pm.response.code === 201) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.authorUserId).to.not.eql('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'); pm.expect(body.noteId).to.not.eql('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'); pm.expect(body.createdOnUtc).to.not.include('2000-01-01'); pm.expect(body.authorUserId).to.not.eql(pm.request.body.raw ? JSON.parse(pm.request.body.raw).authorUserId : undefined); }

item.name: [no-route] A review note has no update or delete verb

request.description: Append-only is a route-level guarantee: no PUT, PATCH or DELETE route exists for a review note, so a note's text can never change and a note can never be removed through the API, and no 409 or 5xx path is reachable from request input. This request documents that boundary — the route does not exist — so no note is altered. Run "List caregiver review notes" first to populate noteId.

exec: pm.test('no note update or delete route exists', () => pm.expect([404, 405, 401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code));

item.name: Role denial is not a note read

request.description: Both review-note routes use the existing CaregiverReviewAdmin policy: authenticated, access_type Normal, account_type SuperAdmin (5) or SupportAdmin (7). ContentAdmin, FinanceAdmin, Care Home owners, Family, Elderly and Caregiver tokens are 403 and a missing, expired or non-Normal token is 401; a denied caller never receives a 200 page or a 201 body. No new policy was added for this phase. Replace accessToken to exercise the denial.

exec: pm.test('caregiver note routes are policy-guarded', () => pm.expect([200, 401, 403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));
if (pm.response.code === 403) pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('title');

request.description: The dedicated CaregiverLookupAdmin policy - NOT the shared review policy above: account_type SuperAdmin (5) or FinanceAdmin (9) with access_type Normal; SupportAdmin's prior access is removed and ContentAdmin and every app audience are 403. Resolves a caregiver name to the caregiver aggregate id the review routes take - not the Identity user id. search is an optional case-insensitive substring of the Arabic or English full name; the caller's text is matched literally (% and _ are not wildcards) and a blank or unmatched search is never an error. Paging is clamped and echoed back: page is at least 1, pageSize defaults to 20 and is capped at 100. Items are ordered by Arabic name, then English name, then caregiver id. Each item carries id, arabicFullName and englishFullName and nothing else - phone and email are neither searchable nor returned here, so phone lookup stays on the SuperAdmin-only admin user list, and bank, payout and medical columns are never selected. Caregivers without a linked Identity user row are not returned; their rows are kept and still report identityPresent on the review list. The envelope is items, page, pageSize, totalCount, totalPages.

exec: pm.test('caregiver lookup contract', () => pm.expect([200, 401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code));

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('page'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('pageSize'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('totalCount'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('totalPages'); pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.pageSize).to.be.at.most(100); if (body.items.length > 0) { pm.expect(body.items[0]).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(body.items[0]).to.have.property('arabicFullName'); pm.expect(body.items[0]).to.have.property('englishFullName'); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(body), 'phoneNumber must never be published').not.to.include('phoneNumber'); } }
